title: uncaria domatiifera subsp. xerophila
intro: Uncaria domatiifera subsp. xerophila, commonly known as Gac, is a plant species native to Vietnam, used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain, inflammation, and oxidative stress in the body. The therapeutic actions of Uncaria domatiifera subsp. xerophila are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of Uncaria domatiifera subsp. xerophila for various health applications.
